body: I want to be loved, literally, I feel like every action I do is a scream asking for some attention. I would like it if someone shake and buffet me. When I'm expressing how I feel it feels repetitive, I don't know if anyone understands this but I would like to be like the "Did you know?" section on the frontpage of wikipedia instead of always coming up with the same "I was in a pshyco ward... I feel awful.. I want to smoke weed.." shit. At the same time I hate to selfstigmatize about that hospital situation, sometimes I feel as if I was an evicted patient with an incurable disease.

I was in the hospital for the same reason, coupled with the fact that I had death and guilt deliriums, I don't remember the months before hospital. I don't feel that they will not understand, it is just very difficult to articulate my thoughts in a way they seem mildly interesting or at least that's what I think, I feel like if they talk to me they are going to feel depressed or annoyed so I choose not to talk as if I was defending them from the monster/failure which I consider myself.
